summary: Signal Stage is a multiplayer, walkable motion-graphics stage whose shared 198-second, 160-bpm cinematic is synchronized by world.state.cine. Scripted field, eye, tunnel, chamber and sun-eye assemblies share a trip clock, seeded visual choices and a trip-specific full-screen look.
places: places/main/config.yaml (main, 3D) - black void, terrain off, spawn at (0, 0.1, 16), gravity -24Y; scripts/look-trip.js is the place-wide look.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - stage director, field and eye assemblies around the origin, floor, and a serpents blueprint placeholder.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - sun-eye, drips and halo at (0, 62, -90), plus five trip-tagged tunnel layers at (0, 9, -186).
places/main/cells/x0z-3.scene - trip-tagged chamber layers; chamber-mask stands at (0, 15, -366), facing +Z, between the hands.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: multiplayer, player/camera templates, P/jump/movement inputs, arrival, lighting, HUD and nametag.
templates/player.js#player - character root composing locomotion with player movement and cine input.
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-person camera; follows seeded shot flight during a roll, ordinary look pose otherwise.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - all-audience scripts/stage.js director for synchronized audio and trip parameters.
scripts/ui.js - viewer-local ROLL/CUT and cinematic progress/section HUD.
places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look - installs scripts/look-trip.js as the full-screen trip post-processing look.
shared: scripts/lib/cine.js - CPU score clock, section lookup and camera interpolation shared by player, camera, director and HUD.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml and scripts/lib/data/shots.yml - track timing, sections, layer windows, lens/math score and camera keyframes.
scripts/lib/data/tropes.yml - TAS-inspired and original motif catalogue grouped by owning piece; piece shaders implement variants.
scripts/lib/trip.js - shared shader clock, seeded choices, beat/audio envelopes, palettes, layer visibility and UV lens bending.
scripts/field-lib.js, scripts/eye-lib.js, scripts/tunnel-lib.js, scripts/chamber-lib.js and scripts/chamber-fx.js - family-specific geometry/shader helpers.
scripts/sun-lib.js - sun-eye timing, hue, ripple, symmetry and relighting shared by sun-disc, sun-drips and sun-halo materials.
scripts/serpents-data.js and scripts/serpents-curve.js - body records and shared closed-form spine/frame calculations used by serpent tube and bead geometry.
notableExports: scripts/player.js exports onInput, update; scripts/camera.js exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/stage.js exports update; scripts/lib/cine.js exports SCORE, SHOTS, CINE, cineTime, sectionAt, rollRnd, cameraAt, beatEnv.
scripts/lib/trip.js exports SCORE, SEC, BPS, tripClock, win, pal, stripes, HUE, shown, lens, bendUv; scripts/look-trip.js exports look.
scripts/field-disc.js exports geometry; field-mandala.js exports material; field-orbs.js and field-stalks.js export geometry with paired materials.
scripts/eye-*-geo.js export geometry; eye-iris.js, eye-beads.js, eye-lids.js, eye-pupil.js and eye-rays.js export materials.
scripts/tunnel-geo.js exports geometry, collider; tunnel-lib.js exports spatial/color helpers, fam, deal, pinch, light, cut and panels; tunnel layer scripts export materials.
scripts/chamber-*-geo.js export geometry/collider where defined and chamber-*-mat.js export materials; chamber-lib.js exports beam, polyline, bead; chamber-fx.js supplies shader helpers.
scripts/sun-lib.js exports TAU, PI, live, sel, breath, ripple, barStep, order, sweep, fam, relight, allLit; sun-disc.js, sun-drips.js and sun-halo.js export material.

scripts/sun-quad-geo.js and chamber-mask-geo.js export geometry, collider; chamber-mask-mat.js exports material; sun-drips-geo.js exports RIM, geometry, collider; scripts/serpents-data.js exports Q0, BODIES.
ownership: scripts/player.js - owns local movement intent/velocity and writes shared world.state.cine = {start, by, seed} or null on cine input.
scripts/stage.js on #director - owns director session and shared track audio; propagates t0/on/seed to trip-tagged materials and place look params.
scripts/camera.js / templates/camera.js - owns viewer-local rolling flag and camera pose/FOV; seeded cameraAt path replaces look orientation only during the roll.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - owns avatar gait/sit animation and locomotion scratch; player.js owns input intent and movement velocity.
scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - own viewer-local presentation, not synchronized cinematic state.
places/main/config.yaml owns atmosphere, spawn, gravity, terrain mode and look params; world.config.yaml owns world services, inputs and templates.
flows: world.config.yaml cine action (P) or HUD sendAction('cine') → scripts/player.js onInput → world.state.cine = {start: now + 300 ms, by, seed} or null.
world.state.cine → scripts/ui.js render → viewer-local ROLL/CUT and rolling progress/section label.
world.state.cine + score music → placed #director running scripts/stage.js → shared non-spatial track at timeAt=c.start; director stops audio and clears ended cine.
scripts/stage.js → params.t0/on/seed for trip-tagged materials and place look params; trip materials consume the same synchronized roll.
score.yml + shots.yml → scripts/lib/cine.js cineTime/cameraAt → scripts/camera.js sets each viewer's seeded camera flight; ends back at look orientation.
score.yml → scripts/lib/trip.js tripClock/SEC, shown(), lens() → field, eye, tunnel and chamber shader materials for clock, scored cutouts and lens parameters.
world.state.cine.seed → stage material params.seed → trip.js c.rnd/c.pick/c.hue/c.dir → seeded palette, directions and motif variations across pieces.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml layer windows → trip.js shown(c,name,d) → piece material opacity/cutout, exposing layers behind instead of fading to black.
scripts/tunnel-geo.js kind-selected geometry → five tunnel layers; tunnel-lib.js shared frame, roll hue, trope-deck and depth-pinch helpers are consumed by tunnel materials.
chamber-mask in x0z-3.scene → chamber-mask-geo.js mirrored line-art geometry + chamber-mask-mat.js material; chamber-fx.js supplies shared chamber timing and roll-derived colors.
scripts/sun-lib.js → sun-disc.js, sun-drips.js, sun-halo.js; their trip/sun tags let stage.js synchronize the sun-eye with the roll.

places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look params → scripts/look-trip.js → full-screen score-driven post-processing; world.config.yaml movement/jump actions → scripts/player.js → character velocity, with templates/player.js also running humanoid locomotion.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/field-* - mandala disc, stalks and orbs; field-lib.js shares timing/placement math, while separate geometry and materials vary motifs and seeded tropes.
scripts/eye-* - iris, pupil, rays, lids and beads compose the portal; eye-iris-geo.js is reused for iris and pupil with different parameters, eye-lib.js shares eye math.

scripts/tunnel-* - five visual layers share tunnel-geo.js kind-selected geometry and tunnel-lib.js spatial/color helpers; materials differ in wall/core/dust/gate/rib imagery and use a roll-seeded palette.
scripts/chamber-* - placed room, circuit, hands, hex, Lissajous, solids and bilateral mask layers share chamber geometry/shader helpers and scored cutouts.
scripts/sun-disc.js, sun-drips.js, sun-halo.js - three co-located sun-eye layers share sun-lib.js; separate disc, hanging-drip and depth-halo shaders vary the imagery.

scripts/look-trip.js and scripts/lib/trip.js - place-wide post-processing and scene shaders consume the same score clock, seeded selection and palette utilities; look-trip mirrors line-art/peak elements and preserves black between forms.
scripts/serpents-geo.js and scripts/serpents-beads-geo.js - tube mesh and spine bead rows share BODIES and closed-form curve/frame helpers; x0z0.scene still has only the blueprint placeholder.
templates/player.js composes humanoid-locomotion.js and player.js on each character: gait/sit animation versus movement intent and velocity.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js and scripts/lib/data/world.yml - terrain generator/data without a consumer while main terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/pebble.js - meadow decoration code with no current place consumer.
migrationNotes: world.state.cine is the synchronized start/cut source; starts are scheduled 300 ms ahead. cine.js uses milliseconds for c.start/ctx.now() and seconds for score/shot keys.
The roll seed lives in world.state.cine.seed and stage.js pushes it with t0/on; add trip materials to the trip tag to receive all three parameters.
stage.js converts c.start to shader t0 seconds modulo 3600 and repeats parameter pushes for several ticks so late-built materials receive the roll.
Score is 198 seconds at 160 bpm, first beat 0.35 s; shader tripClock follows the roll when on and otherwise free-runs the silent duration loop.
Coordinates are metres, +Y up: field (0,0,0), upright eye (0,15,-34), sun-eye (0,62,-90), tunnel runs -Z from -36 to -336, chamber mask at (0,15,-366).

Chamber colors now derive from the roll's c.hue; tunnel-lib's deal/pinch helpers and seeded tunnel palette vary with the same trip context. Layer hiding remains shader opacity/cutout via shown(), not a black fade.
